Nederland is een van de meest seculiere: The Netherlands is one of the most secular countries in Western Europe. The generation we most want to reach never walks into a church on its own. At the same time, many Christians want to share their story but don't know how. Both groups are waiting for each other.
JesusToday is ontstaan uit een verlangen: JesusToday was born from a desire to bring people into contact with inspiring stories in a simple way. Extraordinary stories from ordinary people, with one common factor: Jesus. Who is this person to whom we owe our calendar? Why do we still talk about him after more than 2000 years? And what is his impact today?
In 2010 kwam ik (Alexander Keur) na een: In 2010, after a year of crisis, I (Alexander Keur) ended up in a church on Christmas Eve where I would normally never go. Here, the birth of Jesus Christ, the Son of God, was celebrated. I had barely any knowledge of the Bible, the church and the Christian tradition, and I also had many reservations and even prejudices about it. Something was triggered that evening. You can hear it in my own story.
Ik had geen idee waar ik met deze nieuwe: I had no idea where I could turn to with this new interest in my life. There is everything online, so many different churches and organizations. Who could help me further and where could I just get first-hand experiences? Just from people like me, telling about what they personally experienced with Jesus.
Er bleken veel mensen te zijn die een pe: It turned out that many people have a personal story about Jesus and wanted to share it. So together with a team of enthusiasts, we started this online platform.
